(text-colour:orange + yellow)["Oh I didn't know that before, but what does that do for me?"]

(text-colour:purple)["It can do a lot of things for you, like help alleviate your anxiety, if it's not bold to assume but do you find yourself irritable, restless, or feel like there's a sense of impending doom, present situation excluded of course."]

(text-colour:orange + yellow)["I- I- I do, lately I haven't been getting any sleep and it's been really hard to focus on making this game for you, I wasn't able to manage it well... clearly."]

passages.text:
(text-colour:purple)["I'm no doctor but you may be suffering from an anxiety disorder, you're having a lot of symptoms of generalized anxiety disorder, and after what just happened, it may be safe to assume you have just had a panic attack..."]

(text-colour:orange + yellow)["Do you think that's what's been affecting my sleep? mood? even work ethic? A little anxiety couldn't do that to me, I'm an all powerful entity in this world!"]

(text-colour:orange)[The architect holds up their hands making more cat png's appear before slowly putting their hands down and looking awkwardly at the player.]

(text-colour:purple)["Seems to me a bit more than *a little* anxiety to me, but you should check with a mental health professional instead of self diagnosing. (text-colour:orange + yellow)["Could you teach me some more?"]

passages.name: The architect beckons you to follow...
passages.text:
(text-colour:orange)[You begin to follow the architect through a hallway with picture frames of the games you've played and moments you've had together.]
(text-colour:orange + yellow)["I wasn't quite sure how to add you're most thoughtful lesson you taught me into a game, sometimes games aren't about the gameplay, the graphics, or the story, but more so about the lessons of interactivity they teach.  The key word there is 'interactivity' something that connects you to the game, or you to someone else, and for me I needed that connection to get the help I needed, and this 'game' was the best way I could think of that."]
(text-colour:orange)[The architect walks up to a door at the end of the hall way and opens it for you to enter.]

passages.name: The door
passages.text:
(text-colour:orange + yellow)["I had planned to make an RPG for you to battle your thoughts and deepest fears like you did with me but I didn't like the idea of all the menu's and buttons in the way it felt too distracting and overwhelming.  Of course some battles will be too tough even for you or the mindfulness techniques in the first place, and that's when I thought of one button that would be useful to anyone who needs help..."]

(text-colour:orange)[Withing the room there is a single button with a simple sentence on it that is all to familiar.  Call for Help. When the button is pressed a QR code appears with resources on mental health awareness.]

(text-colour:orange + yellow)["It's an important option that's always available and in real life we often forget we have that option, so I thought it'd be good to remind the player that it's always okay to ask for help."]

(text-colour:orange + yellow)["It's kind of like how you helped me to breathe and learn these techniques, being able to recognize symptoms of anxiety and help others is the main aim of this final 'game' (if you can call it that LOL) that I made for you. All of this is thanks to you."]
